CheckTitle: EC2 instances with open ingress Elasticsearch and Kibana ports to the internet
Description: EC2 instances found to allow ingress from the internet to Elasticsearch and Kibana ports (TCP: 9200, 9300, 5601).
Risk: Port 9200 exposes the REST API for data indexing/searching, 9300 handles internal node communication, and 5601 serves the Kibana dashboard. Attackers can directly query indexed documents, inject malicious data, or ransom unprotected Elasticsearch instances containing logs and sensitive information.

Recommendation.Text: Ensure access to ports from the internet is limited for EC2 instances. Apply the concept of Least Privilege and limit traffic to sensitive resources.
